## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle late-Míng *kēzhù* 科註 (subsection + interlinear commentary) by **Ǒuyì Zhìxù** 蕅益智旭 ([智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD), 1599–1655) on the **Wú-period (3rd c. CE) translation by Zhī Qiān** 支謙 of the *Fóshuō zhāi jīng* 佛說齋經 (T87 / [KR6c0079](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0079)) — the canonical short sūtra in which the Buddha explains the *bāzhāi* (eight-precepts-and-fast) to the laywoman *Wéiyē* 維耶. Author signature: *Wú yōupósài Zhī Qiān yìjīng / Míng qiújìnán Zhìxù kēzhù* 吳　優婆塞　支謙　譯經／明　求寂男　智旭　科註 — note the selfstyled *qiújìnán* 求寂男 ("seekeraftertranquillity man", i.e. *śrāmaṇera*) below his ordination-name Zhìxù.

**Abstract**

The *Fóshuō zhāi jīng kēzhù* is **the principal late-Míng doctrinal commentary** on the *Bāzhāi* sūtra, integrating Zhìxù's signature *Tiāntáistyle xuányì* technique with practical lay-precept pedagogy. It supplies the doctrinal *lǐ* (principle) framework that complements Hóngzàn's pragmatic *Bāguān zhāifǎ* ([KR6k0234](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0234)). The text-by-text gloss draws on Tiāntái *Púsàjièyìshū* 菩薩戒義疏 (Zhìyǐ's *Bodhisattvaprecept commentary*) for its three-phase analysis. Composition is bracketed by Zhìxù's mature commentary period (from the early 1620s onwards) and his death in 1655; `notBefore`–`notAfter` are 1620–1655.
